description: Style catalogue (TASK-0028, ADR-0012). `phrase` is the visual-characteristics string sent to the image model and shown to the client, held once so the two cannot drift. Variants are recognisable sub-families described by what they look like, never by who makes them (PROD-INV-004). Catalogue images are generated from these strings and are illustrative renders, not photographs of real work.

american_traditional.label: Tradicional americano
american_traditional.phrase: American traditional tattoo flash, bold even outlines, limited flat palette

variants.label: Clásico

variants.label: Moderno
